verdict.rationale: The developer platform page says the DBX Platform lets apps add Dropbox features including 'search', so some search capability is exposed to developers. Nothing in the pack describes a search endpoint, whether it matches filenames only or file contents, or whether it goes beyond prefix matching. The Dash and 'smarter search' marketing is end-user AI search, not a developer API. Missing for 10: a documented search endpoint/reference, evidence of full-text content search via the API, query semantics beyond prefix matching, SDK examples of search, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
